newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil stocks end higher, Telebras leading rise.
newsitem.headline: Brazil stocks end higher, Telebras leading rise.

text.p: Brazil shares ended up 0.49 percent with bellwether Telebras continuing to lead the rise, traders said.
The Bovespa index of the 52 most traded shares ended up 281 points at 65,883 points. Turnover was moderate at 426.7 million reais ($418.5 million).
Traders said the market was interested in Telebras ahead of the options settlements next month. They forecast a support level for Telebras preferred at 84.50 reais at the settlement.
Telebras preferred closed at 81.70 reais, up 0.49 percent.
The common stock ended up 1.2 percent at 67.30 reais.
The bourse is seen rising next week, but analysts said the market will be keeping an eye on the U.S. Federal Reserve Board meeting next Tuesday when it will consider changes in U.S. interest rates.
Among other big winners, state-owned power firm Eletrobras preferred shares rose 1.37 percent to close at 297 reais. Oil monopoly Petrobras common shares ended at 81 reais, up 1.9 percent.
Banco do Brasil was the big loser of the day with its preferred shares closing at 9.70 reais, down 3 percent, after it reported a tiny net profit of 45.1 million reais in August.
In the first half, Banco do Brasil posted the country's largest ever commercial loss, 7.8 billion reais, after posting a 4.2 billion real loss in 1995.
